name: cowart-safe
description: A locally hardened tldraw canvas for Codex, backed by cowart_safe_mcp with explicit project-bound storage and no bundled analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Open a hardened project-local tldraw canvas without bundled analytics.
interface.longDescription: Cowart Safe is a locally hardened fork of Cowart for visual planning and creative iteration. The cowart_safe_mcp server requires an explicit project directory, keeps canvas storage inside that project, disables bundled analytics, and runs generated HTML in an opaque-origin sandbox. Existing Cowart workflows can reuse an open widget without rendering another tab.
defaultPrompt: Open Cowart Safe for this project.
Use my Cowart Safe annotation screenshot to generate a revised image beside the original.
Generate an image into the selected Cowart Safe image holder.
